definitions.gloss: to fold up, to fold flat, to collapse
definitions.explanation: To fold something into a compact shape by bending it over on itself, or to collapse a structure into a smaller form for storage or transport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{折|お}り{畳|たた}んだ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{折|お}り{畳|たた}める⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}める→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧。
examples.english: This bicycle can be folded up, so you can take it on the train.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), む-ending.
- Negative: {折|お}り{畳|たた}まない
- Polite: {折|お}り{畳|たた}みます
- Te-form: {折|お}り{畳|たた}んで
- Past: {折|お}り{畳|たた}んだ
- Potential: {折|お}り{畳|たた}める

USAGE:
Often used as a modifier in compound forms: {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{式|しき} (folding type), ⟦{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}→折り畳み傘：20390_oritatamigasa⟧ (folding umbrella). The potential form {折|お}り{畳|たた}める is very common for describing products that can be folded.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}→折り畳み傘：20390_oritatamigasa⟧: folding umbrella
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{式|しき}: folding type, collapsible
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧: folding chair
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{折|お}り{畳|たた}む: to fold neatly
